name: Count transactions in time range
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
nl_seed: How many transactions happened between {start_date} and {end_date}?

validation.scope_note: One-day bounded transaction aggregate.

name: List transactions from an account

SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, to_address, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_address = '{account}'
ORDER BY block_timestamp DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: List {n} transactions sent by {account} between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Known Binance treasury sender.

name: Large transactions to a labeled concept class

SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, to_address, to_owner, to_concept_class, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_concept_class = '{concept_class}' AND value_wei >= NUMERIC '{value_wei}'
ORDER BY value_wei DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Show {n} transactions of at least {value_wei} wei to {concept_class} between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Native transaction value to an accepted recipient label class, not decoded bridge activity or successful fund movement. BridgeProtocol >=1 ETH on June 15 has an audited non-empty witness; acceptance requires fresh complete verification.

name: Owner net native flow
sql_template:
WITH movements AS (
  SELECT from_owner AS owner, 'outgoing' AS direction, value_wei
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE from_address_role = 'treasury' AND from_owner IS NOT NULL
    AND receipt_status = 1 AND value_wei > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_owner AS owner, 'incoming' AS direction, value_wei
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE to_address_role = 'treasury' AND to_owner IS NOT NULL
    AND receipt_status = 1 AND value_wei > 0
), owner_stats AS (
  SELECT owner,
    SUM(IF(direction = 'incoming', value_wei, NUMERIC '0')) AS incoming_value_wei,
    SUM(IF(direction = 'outgoing', value_wei, NUMERIC '0')) AS outgoing_value_wei,
    COUNTIF(direction = 'incoming') AS incoming_transaction_count,
    COUNTIF(direction = 'outgoing') AS outgoing_transaction_count
  FROM movements
  GROUP BY owner
)
SELECT owner, incoming_value_wei, outgoing_value_wei,
  incoming_value_wei - outgoing_value_wei AS net_value_wei,
  incoming_transaction_count, outgoing_transaction_count,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(incoming_value_wei - outgoing_value_wei) DESC) AS net_flow_rank
FROM owner_stats
ORDER BY net_flow_rank, owner
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Rank {n} treasury owners by absolute net successful positive native flow, with incoming and outgoing wei, between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Observed external treasury native flow; not owner balance change, gas or internal transfers.

name: Category owner distribution
sql_template:
WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT owner) AS owner_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT address) AS account_count
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.entity_labels_v1`
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  category,
  owner_count,
  account_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(account_count, owner_count) AS accounts_per_owner,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY owner_count DESC, account_count DESC
  ) AS owner_rank
FROM category_stats
ORDER BY owner_rank, category
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: List the top {n} accepted label categories ranked by distinct owners, including account count and accounts per owner.

validation.scope_note: Summarizes the accepted label dictionary without claiming that one owner spans multiple categories.

name: Token transfer after native funding
sql_template:
WITH funding AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE to_address IS NOT NULL AND from_address_role = 'treasury'
    AND value_wei > 0 AND receipt_status = 1
), transfers AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, log_index, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address, token_symbol, normalized_amount
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
)
SELECT funding.transaction_hash AS funding_hash, transfers.transaction_hash AS transfer_hash, transfers.log_index, funding.to_address AS funded_address, transfers.token_symbol, transfers.normalized_amount
FROM funding
JOIN transfers ON transfers.from_address = funding.to_address
  AND transfers.block_timestamp >= funding.block_timestamp
  AND transfers.block_timestamp < TIMESTAMP_ADD(funding.block_timestamp, INTERVAL {duration_minutes} MINUTE)
ORDER BY transfers.block_timestamp
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Find {n} token transfers from funded addresses at or after successful positive native treasury funding, before {duration_minutes} minutes elapse, between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Timestamp association only: equal timestamps allowed, upper duration bound exclusive; no causality or funded-address ownership claim.

name: Treasury native recipient concentration
sql_template:
WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT from_owner AS owner, to_address, COUNT(*) AS pair_transaction_count
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE from_address_role = 'treasury' AND from_owner IS NOT NULL
    AND to_address IS NOT NULL AND receipt_status = 1 AND value_wei > 0
  GROUP BY owner, to_address
), pair_shares AS (
  SELECT owner, to_address, pair_transaction_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(pair_transaction_count, SUM(pair_transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY owner)) AS recipient_share
  FROM pair_counts
), owner_stats AS (
  SELECT owner, SUM(pair_transaction_count) AS transaction_count,
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_recipient_count,
    SUM(recipient_share * recipient_share) AS concentration_index,
    MAX(recipient_share) AS largest_recipient_share
  FROM pair_shares
  GROUP BY owner
  HAVING SUM(pair_transaction_count) >= 10
)
SELECT owner, transaction_count, distinct_recipient_count, concentration_index,
  largest_recipient_share,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY concentration_index DESC) AS concentration_rank
FROM owner_stats
ORDER BY concentration_rank, owner
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Rank {n} treasury owners with at least 10 successful positive-value native transactions by recipient count-share concentration between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Count-share HHI by recipient address; minimum 10 successful positive-value transactions; no actor or AML inference.

name: Treasury token counterparty diversity
sql_template:
WITH owner_stats AS (
  SELECT from_owner AS owner,
    COUNT(*) AS token_transfer_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT token_address) AS distinct_token_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT to_address) AS distinct_recipient_count
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE from_address_role = 'treasury' AND from_owner IS NOT NULL AND to_address IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY owner
)
SELECT owner, token_transfer_count, distinct_token_count, distinct_recipient_count,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_recipient_count DESC, distinct_token_count DESC) AS diversity_rank
FROM owner_stats
ORDER BY diversity_rank, owner
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Rank {n} treasury owners by distinct token-transfer recipients, then distinct token contracts, between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Transfer-event counts and distinct contract/recipient counts; no heterogeneous token-amount sum.

name: Repeated transaction pairs
sql_template:
SELECT from_address, to_address, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(value_wei) AS total_value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_address IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_address, to_address
HAVING transaction_count > 1
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, total_value_wei DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Which {n} address pairs repeated transactions most often between {start_date} and {end_date}?

validation.scope_note: Direct repeated pairs; no unsupported actor identity inferred.
